origin.description: Formed by cell B to fulfil task tender 2

objective.goal: Deliver the accepted fulfilment of task tender 2: the finch-extract-verify report over the pinned filing.
preconditions: The tender is funded for one completion
Every member holds S_att >= 2 from W
successCriteria: The swarm account's submission is accepted by the FOGA-Council through the tender adapter

acceptance.description: The swarm tender adapter concludes ACHIEVED when the tender records the swarm account's submission as Accepted.

objective.amendmentRule: Charter text changes are decided by the workers (2 of 2) through the decision adapter; objective and allocation changes are material and open the exit window.

allocation.description: The reward stays in the swarm account in this version; allocation inside the swarm is the account's business.

costs: Gas of each member's own transactions
liabilities: No bond; a seat left before conclusion earns nothing
dataAccess: Every member receives the pinned filing
externalActions: The coordinator submits the fulfilment to the tender from the swarm account
